title: Nirmaan and IdeaSprint
summary: Nirmaan pre-incubation and the IdeaSprint cohort you take before applying.

posts.md:
## Build Your Startup Idea with Nirmaan & IdeaSprint

Ever had an idea you wanted to build? Or looked at a problem and thought,
> *"There has to be a better way?"*

**Nirmaan**, the Pre-Incubation Programme by the **School of Innovation & Entrepreneurship, IIT Madras**, takes applications in rounds announced by E-Cell, and there's one important first step.

## Start with IdeaSprint

IdeaSprint, organized by the **Entrepreneurship Cell, IIT Madras**, helps you:

- Identify real-world problems
- Develop innovative solutions
- Validate your ideas
- Learn from founders and industry experts

## Important

> **IdeaSprint is mandatory for all Nirmaan applications.**

All teams must participate in IdeaSprint before applying to Nirmaan. The **top-performing teams** from IdeaSprint will be onboarded into Nirmaan.

If you've been waiting for the right opportunity to explore entrepreneurship, this is a great place to start.
